snapshot.correction: An earlier version of this pack said a mongodump alone was a sufficient snapshot. It is not. document_migration.read_source() reads and hashes the bytes at document.file_path, which holds an ABSOLUTE production path. A Mongo-only restore makes every document classify *_no_file, producing a manifest that reports the whole estate as unrecoverable while appearing healthy.

rejected_methods: ordered live capture (files first, then Mongo)
capture_boundary.why_ordering_is_not_a_boundary: Ordering controls WHICH DIRECTION the two stores disagree. It does not control WHETHER they disagree, and establishing that they do not is the validator's job. A row updated between the two captures carries the new file_path and the old bytes, which surfaces later as a source_lost_in_restore that originated in the capture. Discounting a suspect document by hand from recorded window bounds is the operator overriding the check, not verifying it.
capture_boundary.enforced_in_code: load_capture_manifest refuses any capture_method outside the accepted list; test_ordered_live_capture_is_refused covers it.

capture_manifest_contract.path_token_enforcement: compared against the restored row's own file_path before anything else about that document; a mismatch is a fatal file_path_mismatch reported alone, because a hash checked against the wrong path proves nothing

null_counts_scope: Only counts drawn from production data are null: every affected_count, blocked_records.counts_by_code, and the observed index state. Schema versions, test counts and index key directions are real values and do not come from the estate.

capture_producer.cannot_prove_quiescence: No database client can observe whether application writes were stopped. The producer fingerprints Mongo before and after the artifact scan and stats every file before and after hashing it, refusing if anything moved. Those are tripwires that catch a boundary never held or broken mid-run; they do not establish one and are not a substitute for stopping writes. Every manifest carries producer_cannot_prove_quiescence: true so this travels with the artefact.

output_safety.written_in_binary: text mode translates newlines on Windows, which would break the detached checksum
output_safety.permissions: 0o600 where the platform honours it; Windows ACLs do not
output_safety.prints: counts and the capture id only; no paths, titles, credentials or raw exceptions

capture_producer.two_pass_rationale: A single pass structurally cannot notice a file rewritten AFTER it was hashed -- that file's own before/after stat pair had already closed. Both passes are compared on path_token, source_state, size, sha256 and path_flags; any difference is BOUNDARY_BROKEN.

publication.invariant: a final manifest never exists without a valid checksum
order: publish the manifest LAST as the completion marker
publication.crash_between_publications: leaves an orphan checksum -- detectable, harmless and obviously incomplete. The reverse order would leave a manifest whose integrity nobody could confirm, which looks exactly like a good one.
publication.overwrite: refused for either file, before anything is staged
publication.cleanup: on a HANDLED failure only files this invocation created are removed; a pre-existing file is never touched
publication.abrupt_termination: cannot clean up at all, which is why the ordering rather than the cleanup carries the guarantee

output_protection.windows: icacls /inheritance:r plus a single owner grant, verified by reading the ACL back and refusing if any other principal retains access
output_protection.recorded_as: producer.protection_verified, required true by the contract
output_protection.why_not_chmod_on_windows: Windows ignores chmod beyond the read-only bit, so a POSIX mode check there would pass while the directory stayed readable by everyone

capture_producer.windows_acl_identity: process token SID via advapi32 (whoami /user fallback); granted as *SID and verified from icacls /save SDDL. %USERNAME% is never used and domains are never stripped.
capture_producer.windows_acl_policy: this token SID plus the three principals that cannot be excluded on Windows (SYSTEM S-1-5-18, Administrators S-1-5-32-544, OWNER RIGHTS S-1-3-4). Everyone/Users/Authenticated Users and any other account are refused. An ACL lacking this account is also refused: not-unexpected is not the same as ours.
capture_producer.output_directory_policy: a new directory is created and protected; a pre-existing one is VERIFIED ONLY and refused if not private. The tool never rewrites the ACL of a directory it did not create.
capture_producer.publication_durability_windows: crash-consistent; Windows exposes no directory fsync, so ordering survives a process crash but not power loss

shared_contract.why: The producer and the validator must agree about hashing, canonical serialisation, path tokens, source states and every validation rule. Separate copies that drift make the validator report tooling differences in the language of data loss -- a _stable() differing by one character makes every fingerprint mismatch.
shared_contract.manifest_schema_version_1: refused, not upgraded -- it predates boundary evidence and the fields were never collected

mutation_testing.isolation: every mutation was applied to a throwaway copy of the tree; the repository was read and never written, so an interrupted run cannot leave a modified source file

equivalent.mutation: producer: the directory is not fsynced after the checksum
equivalent.reason: PLATFORM-CONDITIONAL. _sync_directory() returns immediately when os.name == 'nt', because Windows exposes no directory fsync, so removing a call to it cannot change observable behaviour on this machine. On POSIX the call is NOT equivalent and this mutation is expected to be caught there -- which this run cannot demonstrate. Recorded as equivalent for Windows only, and as unverified elsewhere.

mutation_testing.deselected_during_sweep: real_protection -- environment checks that spawn icacls; run once separately against the unmutated tree

contract_drift_testing.coverage_check: a separate test fails if a public contract name is neither imported by a script nor explicitly exempted
